scripts.openapi:generate: pnpm run openapi:tenant && pnpm run openapi:meet && pnpm run openapi:notification
scripts.openapi:join: redocly join services/tenant/openapi.yaml services/meet/openapi.yaml services/notification/openapi.yaml --prefix-components-with-info-prop title -o services/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle services/openapi.yaml --config services/redocly-merge.yaml -o services/openapi.yaml
scripts.openapi:lint: redocly lint services/tenant/openapi.yaml services/meet/openapi.yaml services/notification/openapi.yaml services/openapi.yaml
scripts.openapi: pnpm run openapi:generate && pnpm run openapi:join && pnpm run openapi:lint
